017package org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.data;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.time.*;
022import java.time.format.*;
023import java.util.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.petstore.dto.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.petstore.service.*;
027
028/**
029 * Deterministic demo data for the petstore console: about 500 pets, 2,000 orders, 50 users and 300 audit rows,
030 * generated from a fixed {@link Random} seed and a fixed {@link Clock} so tests and screenshots are repeatable.
031 *
032 * <p>
033 * The classic rows a {@code new PetStore()} loads (pets 1-9, orders 101-103, three users) stay first with their ids;
034 * generated rows follow.  Both runners seed this way on startup.
035 *
036 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
037 * <p class='bjava'>
038 *    <jc>// Default seed and clock (what the runners use).</jc>
039 *    PetStore <jv>store</jv> = PetstoreSeed.<jsm>create</jsm>().populate(<jk>new</jk> PetStore());
040 *
041 *    <jc>// A different but still repeatable data set.</jc>
042 *    PetStore <jv>other</jv> = PetstoreSeed.<jsm>create</jsm>()
043 *       .randomSeed(42L)
044 *       .clock(Clock.<jsm>fixed</jsm>(Instant.<jsm>parse</jsm>(<js>"2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"</js>), ZoneOffset.<jsf>UTC</jsf>))
045 *       .populate(<jk>new</jk> PetStore());
046 * </p>
047 */
048public final class PetstoreSeed {
049
050   /** Default random seed. */
051   public static final long DEFAULT_SEED = 20261004L;
052
053   /** Default clock: fixed at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z, UTC. */
054   public static final Clock DEFAULT_CLOCK = Clock.fixed(Instant.parse("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), ZoneOffset.UTC);
055
056   /** Total pets after {@link #populate(PetStore)}. */
057   public static final int PETS = 500;
058   /** Total orders after {@link #populate(PetStore)}. */
059   public static final int ORDERS = 2000;
060   /** Total users after {@link #populate(PetStore)}. */
061   public static final int USERS = 50;
062   /** Audit rows written by {@link #populate(PetStore)}. */
063   public static final int AUDIT = 300;
064
065   private static final String[] NAMES = {
066      "Biscuit", "Pepper", "Mango", "Nori", "Juniper", "Clover", "Pickle", "Waffles", "Sprout", "Maple",
067      "Pebble", "Olive", "Tofu", "Ziggy", "Hazel", "Basil", "Comet", "Dot", "Fig", "Rusty"
068   };
069   private static final String[] FIRST = { "Ana", "Ben", "Cleo", "Dev", "Eli", "Fay", "Gus", "Hana", "Ivo", "Jo" };
070   private static final String[] LAST = { "Abbott", "Brooks", "Chen", "Diaz", "Evans", "Fischer", "Gray", "Hale" };
071   private static final String USER_FMT = "user%02d";
072   private static final String[] ENTITIES = { "Pet", "Order", "User" };
073   private static final String[] ACTIONS = { "CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE" };
074
075   private long seed = DEFAULT_SEED;
076   private Clock clock = DEFAULT_CLOCK;
077
078   private PetstoreSeed() {}
079
080   /** @return A new seed builder with the default seed and clock. */
081   public static PetstoreSeed create() {
082      return new PetstoreSeed();
083   }
084
085   /**
086    * @param value The {@link Random} seed.
087    * @return This object.
088    */
089   public PetstoreSeed randomSeed(long value) {
090      seed = value;
091      return this;
092   }
093
094   /**
095    * @param value The clock that dates orders and audit rows.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
096    * @return This object.
097    */
098   public PetstoreSeed clock(Clock value) {
099      clock = Objects.requireNonNull(value, "value");
100      return this;
101   }
102
103   /**
104    * Adds the generated rows to a store that holds only the classic rows.
105    *
106    * @param store A freshly constructed store.
107    * @return The same store, for chaining.
108    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the store already holds more than the classic rows.
109    */
110   @SuppressWarnings({
111      "java:S2245" // Demo seed data only; a fixed-seed Random is required for repeatability and is not security-sensitive.
112   })
113   public PetStore populate(PetStore store) {
114      var existing = store.getPets().size();
115      if (existing > 9)
116         throw iaex("PetstoreSeed.populate expects a store holding only the classic rows; found '%s' pets", existing);
117      var r = new Random(seed);
118      var now = clock.instant();
119      var species = Species.values();
120      var orderStatus = OrderStatus.values();
121
122      var pets = new ArrayList<Pet>();
123      for (long id = 10; id <= PETS; id++) {
124         var sp = species[(int)(id % species.length)];
125         var roll = r.nextInt(10);
126         var status = petStatus(roll);
127         pets.add(new Pet().setId(id).setSpecies(sp).setStatus(status)
128            .setName(NAMES[r.nextInt(NAMES.length)] + " " + id)
129            .setPrice(5 + r.nextInt(9_500) / 100f)
130            .setTags(List.of(sp.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))));
131      }
132
133      var users = new ArrayList<User>();
134      for (var n = 4; n <= USERS; n++) {
135         var username = f(USER_FMT, n);
136         users.add(new User().setUsername(username)
137            .setFirstName(FIRST[r.nextInt(FIRST.length)]).setLastName(LAST[r.nextInt(LAST.length)])
138            .setEmail(username + "@example.org").setPassword("demo").setPhone(f("555-01%02d", n))
139            .setUserStatus(r.nextInt(10) == 0 ? UserStatus.INACTIVE : UserStatus.ACTIVE));
140      }
141
142      var day = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE.withZone(ZoneOffset.UTC);
143      var orders = new ArrayList<Order>();
144      for (long id = 104; id <= 2100; id++)
145         orders.add(new Order().setId(id).setPetId(1L + r.nextInt(PETS))
146            .setShipDate(day.format(now.minus(Duration.ofDays(r.nextInt(90)))))
147            .setStatus(orderStatus[r.nextInt(orderStatus.length)]));
148
149      var stamps = new ArrayList<Instant>();
150      for (var i = 0; i < AUDIT; i++)
151         stamps.add(now.minus(Duration.ofMinutes(1L + r.nextInt(90 * 24 * 60))));
152      stamps.sort(Comparator.naturalOrder());
153      var audit = new ArrayList<AuditEntry>();
154      for (var i = 0; i < AUDIT; i++) {
155         var kind = r.nextInt(3);
156         var entity = ENTITIES[kind];
157         var entityId = switch (kind) {
158            case 0 -> String.valueOf(1 + r.nextInt(PETS));
159            case 1 -> String.valueOf(101 + r.nextInt(ORDERS));
160            default -> f(USER_FMT, 4 + r.nextInt(USERS - 3));
161         };
162         var actor = r.nextInt(4) == 0 ? PetStore.ACTOR_API : "console:" + f(USER_FMT, 4 + r.nextInt(USERS - 3));
163         audit.add(new AuditEntry().setId(i + 1L).setAt(stamps.get(i)).setActor(actor)
164            .setEntity(entity).setEntityId(entityId).setAction(ACTIONS[r.nextInt(ACTIONS.length)]));
165      }
166
167      store.load(pets, orders, users, audit);
168      return store;
169   }
170
171   private static PetStatus petStatus(int roll) {
172      if (roll < 6)
173         return PetStatus.AVAILABLE;
174      return roll < 8 ? PetStatus.PENDING : PetStatus.SOLD;
175   }
176}
